title: A little something I've been cooking up for the last couple of months.
author: Count_JohnnyJ
selftext:
A modern remake that marries several of my favorite childhood games, including Star Wars Rebellion, Empire at War, Star Wars Battlefront, and X-wing/Tie Fighter/X-wing Alliance. A full galaxy with over 500 canon-based and canon-positioned planets. Play it as a tactical RTS, or as a combat simulator, or both at the same time. The Empire find your secret base? Death Star giving you trouble? Take the stick yourself and do something about it while you give command to a capable admiral. 

Does the ground team need more reinforcements? Get new orders from the Admiral to escort the troop landers to the ground battle, or land your fighter and take part in the command post based skirmish yourself. 

[https://youtu.be/CAZD9we8f88](https://youtu.be/CAZD9we8f88)
